replacement_rule: Keep anchors that passed individual prefix replay. Exclude anchors whose replay has a nonpositive margin or a changed token. Resample only their original group and wording cells, with the same rankings and cap. Apply to preservation and calibration. Both update arms receive the same final anchors.
scope: Development evidence collection only. Reuse hash-verified unchanged-parent measurements from the first fit. No transfer-validation, selection, or hidden outcomes enter the repair or fitting.
